notes.title: Early Access v0.0.35-dev Update Released!
notes.notes:
🌟 Hello everyone! 🌟

After the launch of the Early Access, it’s been an incredibly intense but truly rewarding day! 🥳 I’d like to thank you all for the support, involvement, and kindness you’ve shown. ❤️

On this first day:
📋 I’ve received over 200 reports, including bugs and suggestions.
⚽ More than 750 matches have been played in total. It’s mind-blowing—thank you so much, I’m truly speechless! 🙌

To keep up this positive momentum, I’ve just released version v0.0.35-dev, which includes:

✨ Suggestions implemented:

📝 @Foni: The top scorers list has been expanded to 20.
🐞 Bugs fixed:

🛠️ @KimRoss: Injured players no longer remain at 0 recovery days without being able to play.
🛠️ @Balaguer: The matchday name now appears in Spanish when the game is set to that language.
🛠️ @Chiadow: The calendar no longer resets to August when reaching December.
🛠️ @Chiadow + @Foni: When making an offer for a player in the transfer market, the club they belong to now displays correctly.
🛠️ @Chiadow: At the start of a new season, previous transfer statuses are no longer carried over to different teams.
Thank you so much again, team! 💪 Let’s keep it up—tomorrow, even better! 🚀

notes.title: Version v.0.0.30-dev released
notes.notes:
[center][b]Hello everyone![/b] 🚀 I’m excited to announce the release of [b]version v0.0.30-dev[/b], which includes the following updates and new features:[/center]

[hr][/hr]

[b]New Features & Updates:[/b]
• [b]⚽ Top Scorers Table:[/b] Now available to check the leading scorers.
• [b]🏆 Steam Achievements:[/b] Added the missing achievements.
• [b]📊 Promotion League Results:[/b] Displaying results of ongoing promotion leagues.
• [b]🐞 Bug Fix:[/b] Resolved the issue reported by @kaozz17, where goal stats continued accumulating incorrectly over multiple seasons.
• [b]📈 Opponent’s Average in Dashboard:[/b] View the opposing team’s average performance! (Still working on design placement, but functionality is live.)
• [b]💪 Player Morale:[/b] Morale now fluctuates based on players’ participation in matches, adding a new layer of realism.
• [b]💥 Splash Screen:[/b] A new splash screen on startup for an enhanced experience.
• [b]👥 Rival Team Rosters:[/b] You can view other teams' rosters directly from the standings table.
• [b]🔄 Transfer System:[/b] Initial steps toward player transfers.
• [b]📮 Feedback Form:[/b] A new form in the main menu to share your feedback and suggestions.

[hr][/hr]

[b]What’s Next:[/b]
• [b]🌐 New Website:[/b] A website with updated information is in development.
• [b]🛠️ Database Editor:[/b] Advancing the editor to make customization easier.
• [b]💰 Transfer System:[/b] Further improvements to balance the game’s economy.

[hr][/hr]

[center]Thank you all for your support and suggestions! We’re thrilled to keep moving forward together. [b]Looking forward to the next steps![/b] ❤️[/center]
